title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: So if I have to write a column on who the Tigers should pick, who should I say
Are you writing your opinion about who you like the most based on what you know? Or are you writing your prediction for what you think the Tigers will do?

Well idk if I’m the right guy to ask because I’ve only really seen Riley. And I’m obviously biased because he’s my guy. But I really think he will hit, and hit for legit power. Great kid, genuine and infectious personality/smile, had a lot of fun playing the game. It’s tough because he’s a high school guy and we probably want instant (or something close to it) gratification from this draft (ie college). But it doesn’t mean we won’t take him.
Again this year I’m not in the draft room. Covering the LSU regional in Baton Rouge
I know it sounds like I’m covering my ass and being wishy washy but I legitimately don’t know what we’re gonna do. I don’t want to tell you the wrong thing and have it blow up on me/you.
No I feel you. I’m probably just going to put highest impact bat
From what I gather Bleday and Greene have very similar profiles, but bleday is closer to MLB. Vaughn has the best hit tool right now but bleday has more juice
